bio.text: Marquita Bradshaw is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Tennessee in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary.
She was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2020, winning that year's primary and losing the general election, and she lost the 2024 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.
She was born in Memphis, graduated from Central High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Memphis; her career experience includes working as an executive director.
